one_line: Perception (SELD) → Contextual Understanding (ASC + SED + SELD) → Context-Aware Action (Active Noise Control, Soundscape Augmentation, and Intelligent Sound Management), progressing towards adaptive and human-aware intervention.
timing_note: Per-section timings are not specified in the source materials and are left null pending presenter confirmation (Phase 6).

sections.title: Opening & Motivation
sections.summary: Environmental Acoustic Intelligence is framed as Hear → Understand → Reason → Act, linking environmental sensing with purposeful sound intervention.

subsections.title: Key ideas
points: Environmental Acoustic Intelligence: moving from acoustic sensing towards Contextual Understanding and intervention.
Hear → Understand → Reason → Act as the tutorial’s broader framing.
Why acoustics matters for environmental sensing and smart cities: noise, bio-indicators, health, and real-time challenges.

sections.title: Spatial Perception — Data-Centric AI for Acoustics
sections.summary: Spatial perception establishes what happens, when it happens, and where it occurs in an acoustic environment.

subsections.title: Key ideas
points: Sound Event Localization and Detection (SELD): jointly identifying what happens, when it happens, and where it occurs.
The modern SELD pipeline: spatial audio inputs, features, learning, and representations for joint detection and localization.
Scaling perception through synthetic data, spatial self-supervision, audio-visual learning, and language interfaces.

sections.title: Contextual Understanding
sections.summary: Contextual Understanding combines scene, event, and spatial information so that perception can guide later decisions.

subsections.title: Key ideas
points: Complementary roles: ASC characterizes scenes, SED identifies events, and SELD adds location.
From independent pipelines to integrated and multi-task approaches that share contextual information.
Context-aware spatial perception and lightweight deployment for robust situational awareness.

sections.title: Context-Aware Action I — Active Noise Control
sections.summary: Active Noise Control is the largest technical stage, translating contextual acoustic information into practical control.

subsections.title: Key ideas
points: ANC fundamentals and practical systems across personal, built-environment, and distributed settings.
Four challenges for AI-assisted ANC: nonlinearity, slow adaptation, acoustic-path variation, and generalization.
Neural approaches for anti-noise generation, control-filter prediction, acoustic-path modelling, and adaptive coordination.
Real-time performance, system variation, and deployment trade-offs.

sections.title: Context-Aware Action II — Soundscape Augmentation
sections.summary: Soundscape Augmentation extends intervention beyond noise reduction towards positive, context-sensitive acoustic environments.

subsections.title: Key ideas
points: Beyond noise reduction: designing positive soundscapes through purposeful augmentation.
Sense → analyse → augment as the operating loop.
Data-driven masker selection and real-world deployment and evaluation.

sections.title: Towards Intelligent Sound Management
sections.summary: Intelligent Sound Management applies sensing, control, and rendering to adaptive listening for hearables.

subsections.title: Key ideas
points: Sensing, control, and rendering as an integrated hearables framework.
Semantic and spatially aware sound management, including selective enhancement and control.
Programmable, adaptive, and human-aware listening systems.

sections.title: Conclusions & New Research Activities
sections.summary: The tutorial closes by connecting physical control with semantic, contextual, and human-aware intervention.

subsections.title: Key ideas
points: Capability progression: physical control → acoustic and spatial features → semantic understanding → contextual decision → human-aware adaptation.
A fast Perceive → Act control loop combined with a slower intelligence and adaptation plane.
Listen with Understanding and Act with Purpose.
